description: Hand-labeled text snippets with a known-correct final confidentiality level, for scoring graphrag.confidentiality.classify_document_confidentiality() end-to-end (deterministic signals + Gemini call + safe combination). Distinct from the existing test_confidentiality_classifier.py unit tests, which exercise the deterministic signal detector and combination logic in isolation with synthetic inputs -- these cases exercise the full pipeline including the live LLM call.
